title: DEMO EASY QUESTION AFTER MAP
why: The opening map hid the easy question while its 12 seconds ran out. The initials card claimed a top 10 although the board keeps 20.
now: The easy question gets 12 seconds after the opening map closes in each window. The initials card uses the board title.

edits.replacement: ARCADE.easy=0; ARCADE.easyAsked=0; ARCADE.easyAsk={at:Date.now(),waitMap:mapFirstOn()?1:0};   // v28.xx (cw-cx-easymapwords): his 2.28 c, each demo player chooses before the run; the clock waits for this window opening map
